source_excerpts.text:
I have not resolved the unrestricted Hamiltonian quantum-PCP compiler statement. I do not have either the required constant-locality, constant-dimensional compiler or a theorem excluding every such compiler.

I did obtain a complete, constructive result about a central possible bridge: constant combinatorial soundness does not imply constant normalized ground energy even when the local dimension, locality, projector alphabet, coefficient precision, and interaction degree are all fixed. This goes beyond the nearly parallel, size-dependent projector example: the local matrices in the construction below never change as the system grows.

The full proof, construction costs, additional attempted interfaces, and source-access record are preserved in    Quantum_PCP_Energy_Composition_20261108.txt.


1. The completed separation theorem

For a normalized projector Hamiltonian, define its combinatorial energy by
$\chi_{\mathrm{comb}}(H)
=
\inf_\rho
\frac{\left|\{e:\operatorname{Tr}(h_e\rho)>0\}\right|}{m},$
where $\rho$ ranges over all states, including arbitrary entangled and mixed states.


Theorem

For every integer $K\ge720000$, set $N=K^2$. There is a uniform deterministic construction of
$H_K=\frac1{m_K}\sum_{e=1}^{m_K}h_e$
such that
$\boxed{
\frac32N\le m_K\le2N,\qquad
\chi_{\mathrm{comb}}(H_K)\ge\frac13,\qquad
0<\lambda_{\min}(H_K)\le\frac{288}{\sqrt N}.
}$
The construction has the following properties.





Requirement | Constructed family | 
Local dimension | Qubits | 
Locality | Two | 
Terms | Rank-one projectors | 
Local matrix alphabet | At most four fixed matrices | 
Coefficients | Fixed rational real and imaginary parts | 
Maximum site degree | Four | 
Maximum term-overlap degree | Six | 
Combinatorial soundness | Against every entangled state | 
Low-energy witness | Explicit product state | 
Complete Hamiltonian description | $O(N\log N)$ bits | 
Deterministic construction | $O(N^3\operatorname{polylog}N)$ bit work in the usual log-cost indexed model | 




If “rational Hermitian” is interpreted as requiring strictly real rational entries, there is also a version with locality two and local dimension four, or locality four on qubits, with the same quantitative separation.

Thus no positive lower bound depending only on the fixed alphabet, locality, dimension, overlap bound, and combinatorial gap can give the required energy implication for this class.
